title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The local RFE snapshot is authoritative because Jira is unavailable in this environment.
No persona catalog was available, so persona IDs were synthesized from the RFE roles.
The prototype demonstrates frontend behavior only; BFF storage, encoding, ASR routing, and model registry integrations are represented by visible status and messages.
Video, PDF upload, microphone capture, multimodal output, streaming, and more than one media file per conversation are out of scope per the strategy.
